root_cause.text: The q6apm ASoC components were removed in the wrong teardown order, so q6apm’s `.remove` path deleted topology/PCM RTDs before dependent DAI child components had been unregistered, leaving stale card-linked components and causing a NULL dereference on rebind.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit says “the q6apm-audio .remove callback unloads topology and removes PCM runtimes during ASoC teardown,” which “deletes the RTDs that contain the q6apm DAI components before their removal pass runs,” and the fix sets `remove_order` to make child components remove first (`SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_FIRST` / `EARLY`) and `q6apm_audio_component` remove last (`SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST`).

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The q6apm ASoC components were removed in the wrong teardown order, so q6apm’s `.remove` path deleted topology/PCM RTDs before dependent DAI child components had been unregistered, leaving stale card-linked components and causing a NULL dereference on rebind.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE/commit says “the q6apm-audio .remove callback unloads topology and removes PCM runtimes during ASoC teardown,” which “deletes the RTDs that contain the q6apm DAI components before their removal pass runs,” and the fix sets `remove_order` to make child components remove first (`SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_FIRST` / `EARLY`) and `q6apm_audio_component` remove last (`SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST`).

intent_record.intent_summary: Set the Q6APM FE DAI component to remove early to ensure correct teardown ordering during driver removal.
intent_record.what: A new field assignment, `.remove_order = SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_EARLY,`, was added to the `q6apm_fe_dai_component` `snd_soc_component_driver` initializer.
intent_record.how: This changes the component removal ordering so the Q6APM FE DAI component is torn down earlier during driver/component removal, which can help ensure cleanup happens before dependent resources are destroyed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set the q6apm LPASS DAI component to be removed first to fix component teardown ordering.
intent_record.what: A new initializer field, `.remove_order = SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_FIRST,`, was added to the `q6apm_lpass_dai_component` `snd_soc_component_driver` structure.
intent_record.how: This changes the component's teardown sequencing so the q6apm LPASS DAI component is removed earlier than components using the default removal order, which can prevent shutdown ordering issues and ensure dependent resources are still available when this component is released.

intent_record.intent_summary: Set the q6apm audio component to be removed last to correct teardown ordering during driver cleanup.
intent_record.what: A new field assignment, `.remove_order = SND_SOC_COMP_ORDER_LAST,`, was added to the `q6apm_audio_component` `snd_soc_component_driver` संरचना initializer.
intent_record.how: This changes the component's teardown ordering so that its remove callback is run last among ASoC components, which can help ensure dependent resources remain available until this driver has finished cleaning up.

grouping_result.intent: Set the q6apm audio component to be removed last to correct teardown ordering during driver cleanup.

consistency_review.core_intent: Adjust q6apm audio component removal ordering during driver teardown to ensure correct cleanup sequencing.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly fix the teardown ordering of q6apm audio components, which matches the root cause where components were removed in the wrong order and left stale card-linked state leading to a NULL dereference on rebind.

candidates.rationale: This remove callback was part of the pre-fix teardown path that ran at the wrong time relative to dependent DAI child components, causing q6apm to delete topology/PCM RTDs before those children were unregistered.

vuln_statements.explanation: This remove callback executed the q6apm teardown path at the wrong point in component shutdown ordering, allowing topology/PCM RTDs to be deleted before dependent DAI child components were unregistered, which matches the root cause.
